soft_shadow.comment: Color derives from the light palette's primary_text at resolve time; suppressed on dark pages.

backgrounds.cover: Primary-text navy field with canvas-colored title, or a quiet canvas background.
backgrounds.content: Canvas background with white surface areas used only when grouping is useful.
backgrounds.section: Canvas or primary-text field with one restrained accent cue.
backgrounds.closing: Reuse the cover background treatment for visual closure.

svg_reference.name: academic-bracket
svg_reference.usage: Optional bracket or evidence-rail motif on cover, section, or one representative evidence page.

backgrounds.cover: Clean canvas or primary-text field with one data-point accent.
backgrounds.content: Neutral canvas that leaves charts and labels visually dominant.
backgrounds.section: Canvas background with a sparse coordinate cue when useful.
backgrounds.closing: Return to the cover treatment with one verified takeaway.

svg_reference.name: data-axis
svg_reference.usage: Optional axis, bracket, or data-point motif; never substitute it for an actual chart.

backgrounds.cover: Open canvas with a single focal accent or optional primary-text field.
backgrounds.content: Mostly unboxed canvas with disciplined whitespace.
backgrounds.section: Open canvas with one focal cue and no decorative bands.
backgrounds.closing: Minimal cover echo with one concluding statement.

svg_reference.name: minimal-focus
svg_reference.usage: Optional focal dot or alignment motif used sparingly at structural moments.

backgrounds.cover: Charcoal or off-white editorial field with strong type hierarchy.
backgrounds.content: Off-white canvas with flat image and text regions rather than UI cards.
backgrounds.section: Charcoal field or off-white spread with restrained crop marks.
backgrounds.closing: Reuse the cover contrast and editorial spacing.

svg_reference.name: editorial-crop
svg_reference.usage: Optional crop-mark motif for cover, section, or image-led editorial pages.

backgrounds.cover: Primary-text midnight field with canvas-colored title and restrained blue light.
backgrounds.content: Light canvas with navy text and limited blue emphasis.
backgrounds.section: Alternate a midnight field with a light decision page when it supports pacing.
backgrounds.closing: Return to the midnight cover treatment.

svg_reference.name: midnight-beam
svg_reference.usage: Optional beam motif on cover, section, or closing; do not place it behind body copy.

backgrounds.cover: Primary-text deep-ocean field with canvas-colored title and cyan-blue accents.
backgrounds.content: Pale ocean canvas with white surfaces only where structure needs them.
backgrounds.section: Deep-ocean or pale-canvas field selected by narrative emphasis.

svg_reference.name: ocean-circuit
svg_reference.usage: Optional circuit, node, or signal-path motif on technical overview pages.

backgrounds.cover: Teal-led field or pale canvas with one clear checkpoint.
backgrounds.content: Pale canvas with white surfaces and restrained teal navigation cues.
backgrounds.section: Pale or deep teal field selected for legibility and pacing.

svg_reference.name: teal-checkpoint
svg_reference.usage: Optional checkpoint or handoff motif on service-flow and structural pages.

backgrounds.cover: Cherry or navy statement field with high-contrast title.
backgrounds.content: Warm off-white canvas; cherry is limited to evidence-backed emphasis.
backgrounds.section: Statement field using cherry or navy, not both at equal weight.
backgrounds.closing: Return to the strongest cover color with one concise conclusion.

svg_reference.name: cherry-slash
svg_reference.usage: Optional slash or directional motif for a decisive cover, comparison, or conclusion.

backgrounds.cover: Warm paper-like canvas with one vivid accent and authentic imagery when available.
backgrounds.content: Warm canvas with open collage or process space; avoid fake documentary material.
backgrounds.section: Paper-like field with one optional taped cue.
backgrounds.closing: Reuse the cover paper treatment with a clear next step.

svg_reference.name: studio-tape
svg_reference.usage: Optional tape or studio-note motif; use only when it supports process or iteration.

backgrounds.cover: Warm canvas or coral statement field with navy text contrast.
backgrounds.content: Warm canvas with coral used for motion and emphasis, not body text.
backgrounds.section: Coral-led statement field or warm canvas with one arc.
backgrounds.closing: Reuse the cover energy with one action-oriented conclusion.

svg_reference.name: coral-arc
svg_reference.usage: Optional rising arc or route motif on launch, roadmap, or closing pages.

backgrounds.cover: Earth-toned canvas or forest field with strong text contrast.
backgrounds.content: Warm natural canvas with documentary imagery or open explanatory structure.
backgrounds.section: Forest field or canvas with an optional contour cue.
backgrounds.closing: Return to the cover landscape treatment.

svg_reference.name: moss-contour
svg_reference.usage: Optional contour motif on place, environment, section, or systems pages.

backgrounds.cover: Warm material canvas or terracotta field with grounded typography.
backgrounds.content: Warm canvas with archival or documentary evidence when reliable sources exist.
backgrounds.section: Terracotta or warm-canvas field with one archival cue.
backgrounds.closing: Reuse the cover material treatment for closure.

svg_reference.name: terracotta-stamp
svg_reference.usage: Optional stamp or archival motif on historical, evidence, or section pages.
